name: Retention policies
short_description: Microsoft Purview policies that keep or delete content such as Teams channel messages, chats and site files for a defined period, independently of what users delete.

evidence.quote: A retention policy sits behind archive and delete. So when someone asks what does our governance do? You don't answer
Las etiquetas de retención aplican plazos automáticamente para que los archivos no duren siempre.
